PART A: Basic Operations
A1
```{r}
v<-seq(5,50, by = 5)

print(v)
print(length(v))
print(sum(v))
print(mean(v))

```
A2
```{r}
v <-rep(c(1,2,3), times = 4)
z <-rep(c(1,2,3), times = 4)
print(v)
print(z)
```
A3
```{r}
print(17 %%5)
print(17 %/%5)
print(2*10)
print(sqrt(144))
print(round(pi,3))
```
A4
```{r}
a<-c(2,4,6,8)
b<-c(1,3,5,7)
print(a + b)
print(a * b)
print(a > b)
print(sum(a * b))
```
A5
```{r}
students <-paste("Student-", 1:3,sep="")
print(students)

print(typeof(42))
print(typeof(42L))
print(typeof("42"))
print(typeof(4i))
print(typeof(TRUE))
```
PART B: Data Frames and Conditional Statements

B1
```{r}
students <- data.frame(id = 1:8, 
name= c("Alice","Bruno","Chen","Dana","Eli","Farid","Grae","Hiro"),
sex = c("F","M","M","F","F","M","F","M"),
section = c("A","B","A","C","B","C","A" ,"B"),
midterm = c(78,85,92,67,74,88,95,59),
final= c(82,79,96,71,80,91,93,65),
attendance =c(95,88,100,72,90,85,98,60),
stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
print(students)
```
B2
```{r}
str(students)
dim(students)
names(students)
summary(students)
```
B3
```{r}
students$average <- round(rowMeans(students[, c("midterm", "final")]),1)
print(students)
```
B4
```{r}
students$passed <- 
  students$average >= 70 & students$attendance >= 75
print(students)
```
B5
```{r}
students$standing <-
ifelse(students$average>=90,"Honors",
ifelse(students$average>= 75, "Good", "Needs Support"))

print(students)
```
B6
```{r}
classify <- function(score){
  if (score >= 85){
    return("Distinction")
  }else if (score>= 70){
    return("Merit")
  }else if (score>=50){
    return("Pass")
  }else{
    return("Fail")
    
  }
}
result<-sapply(c(90,73,55,40),classify)
print(result)
```
Part C:  rbind() and cbind()

C1
```{r}
new_students <- data.frame(
  id = c(9, 10),
  name = c("Ines", "Jamal"),
  sex = c("F", "M"),
  section = c("C", "A"),
  midterm = c(81, 70),
  final = c(84, 68),
  attendance = c(92, 80),
  average = c(87, 69),
  passed = c(TRUE, FALSE),
  standing = c("Good", "Needs Support")
)
names(students)
str(students)

all_students <- rbind(students, new_students)

print(all_students)

```

C2
```{r}
quiz <- c(8, 7, 10, 6, 7, 9, 10, 5, 8, 6)

all_students <- cbind(all_students, quiz = quiz)

print(class(all_students))
print(all_students)
```
C3
```{r}
m <- cbind(
  midterm = all_students$midterm,
  final = all_students$final
)

mean_row <- colMeans(m)

m <- rbind(m, mean = mean_row)

print(m)
```
C4
```{r}
bad <- data.frame(wrong_column = 1)

tryCatch(
  rbind(students, bad),
  error = function(e) {
    message("rbind failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  }
)
```
```{r}
# rbind() may produce an error when the data frames have
# different column names or incompatible structures.
# tryCatch() safely catches the error and displays an error
# message instead of stopping the entire R program.
```

Part D:Subsetting
D1
```{r}
print(all_students$name)

print(all_students[["name"]])

print(all_students[, "name"])
```
D2
```{r}
print(all_students[2:5, c("name", "midterm", "final")])
```
D3
```{r}
print(all_students[all_students$attendance > 90, ])
```
D4
```{r}
print(subset(
  all_students,
  sex == "F" &
    section %in% c("A", "C") &
    final >= 75,
  select = c(name, section, final)
))
```
D5
```{r}
print(all_students$name[which.max(all_students$average)])

print(all_students$name[which.min(all_students$average)])
```
D6
```{r}
sorted_students <- all_students[
  order(all_students$average, decreasing = TRUE),
]

print(head(sorted_students, 3))
```

Part E: Basic factor
E1
```{r}
all_students$section <- factor(all_students$section)
all_students$sex <- factor(all_students$sex)

print(levels(all_students$section))
print(levels(all_students$sex))
```

E2
```{r}

print(table(all_students$sex))

print(table(all_students$section))

print(table(all_students$sex, all_students$section))
```

E3
```{r}
print(as.integer(all_students$sex))

# The integers represent the internal numeric codes
# assigned to each factor level.
# They do not represent the actual sex values.

```
E4
```{r}
all_students$sex_label <- factor(
  all_students$sex,
  levels = c("F", "M"),
  labels = c("Female", "Male")
)

print(levels(all_students$sex_label))
```

E5
```{r}
print(summary(all_students$sex_label))

print(tapply(
  all_students$average,
  all_students$sex_label,
  mean
))
```
